verdict.rationale: cubic documents a dedicated cross-repo review feature: you link related repositories so reviews can catch changes that need a matching update elsewhere, such as shared APIs, schemas, docs or release work. Its whole-codebase indexing via the AI wiki and repository-wide context files support coherent understanding of a single large codebase. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of handling large monorepos, detail on how cross-repo context feeds into review findings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo review quality.
